name: The form and internal context of a system
vision_statement: The AI system has a form and its own internal context, and the hub applies to a particular system by providing adapters or declaring the system's internal APIs, databases and files.
opportunities: A system's own data and the integrations it already runs change for reasons of their own, apart from the outside world and from model accuracy. If a system can declare its own sources instead of having parts rewritten for it, any product can adopt the hub.
solution_coherence: Body is the form of the system and the context that belongs to it, and it lets anyone apply the hub to their own system by declaring where the data lives, where requests come from and which enduring integrations the AI may use. Internal Context declares where the system's data lives, whether each source belongs to the system or to a person, and which outside tool reads it, keeps what the system knows in Card Store and keeps the run record. Intake Sources declares where the requests come from. Hands makes sure that the system's own AI tool registry, LLM platform and guardrails are accessible to the AI and used by it.
